# SheetJS Community Edition

Version: 0.20.3 (Apache-2.0), downloaded from the official distribution:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

License: SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt. The original copyright notice is retained in the script.
The full build supports legacy XLS and Czech encodings as well as XLSX.
Loaded only by the Check APP worker when a comparison starts; no runtime CDN dependency.
